so yeah we've been dealing with this counterfeiting problem for ages now and honestly it's gotten out of hand last month alone we found like 200 fake listings on amazon and we don't even have the bandwidth to check alibaba properly the team is only three people and two of them are part time so what we end up doing is this weekly sweep where someone just scrolls through search results for our brand name and screenshots anything suspicious then we put it in a google doc and at the end of the month legal looks at it but by then half the listings are already gone or the sellers changed their names it's really frustrating because we know there's more out there but we just can't keep up and management keeps asking for numbers like how much revenue are we losing but we can't even quantify it properly because our tracking is so ad hoc
